prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome Your New Companion", "Review your companion's traits and confirm their official desktop name.", "Companion Profile & Trait Summary", "Companion Name"]
1: []
2: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay", "Verifying screen overlay permissions and desktop pet rendering status...", "Desktop System Render Status: Ready", "Pet preparing to launch onto desktop..."]
3: ["Desktop Visibility & Controls", "Control your companion anytime using global hotkeys and desktop tray settings.", "Got It!", "Hotkey: Ctrl+Shift+P to summon or hide. Right-click tray icon for full settings."]
4: ["Signing into your registered account ensures all your pets and progress stay synced and restored.", "Account Pet Recovery Active"]
5: ["Crafting Your Custom Companion", "Analyzing upload features and generating desktop animation assets..."]
6: ["Upload a Clear, Single-Subject Photo", "For best results, upload a clear photo featuring one pet or character in good lighting.", "Avoid group shots or heavily shadowed photos for clean pet generation."]
7: ["Choose Your Pet's Journey", "Each path unlocks unique desktop interactions and exclusive companion traits.", "Unlocks Exclusive Behavior & Custom Traits"]
8: ["Quick Sign-In", "Sign in to safe-keep your pet identity and automatically backup desktop companion data.", "Continue"]
9: ["We'll send a system alert as soon as your pet is ready to leap onto your screen."]
